reviews.text:
I entrusted my cat to Karine's care again with complete confidence. In the daily photos, I see him perfectly relaxed or in the middle of an action with a little string—Karine's weapon of mass distraction!

Thank you for the quality of care provided. Thanks to Karine, I'm spending my vacation with complete peace of mind.

This was my first time having my cat looked after, and the experience was very positive. Even with my rather timid cat, Karine knew how to approach him and make him feel comfortable. I recommend her 100%!

Karine looked after our cat Charly for two weeks in April. Charly is usually very timid, but he felt comfortable with Karine and everything went very well! We received updates and photos every day! Absolutely fantastic!

Karine has been taking care of my boy Théo for many years now and I am happy to be able to continue to rely on her services. She is extremely professional and reliable, which is a big reassurance when entrusting her with the care of my cat while I am away. Most importantly, she is clearly a huge cat-lover herself, which shines through in the beautiful photos and updates she sends each day of her visits. Would definitely recommend.

My partner and I used Chat Heureux to look after our cat during the holidays, and we didn't regret our choice for a second. We had an initial meeting to get acquainted and gather all the necessary information to ensure our cat received the best possible care. During their visits, we received a little message with lots of photos.
Our cat particularly appreciated this attentive presence every day while we were away.
We highly recommend them.

Simply the best cat sitter in Paris, and certainly the best in my experience as a cat owner. She is attentive, conscientious, professional, and adores cats. I trust her completely. In short, I highly recommend her!

Moka is the apple of my eye. I'm always a little stressed about leaving her. Having recently moved to the 12th arrondissement, I entrusted her to Karine. Karine is a wonderful cat sitter who quickly earned Moka's trust, and mine too. The photos showed my cuddly and clearly relaxed kitty. What's more, when I returned, everything was spotless: the litter box, Moka's feeding area, the apartment, etc. Thank you, Karine, for giving me such peace of mind. I can now go away without worry.

We entrusted the care of our kitten to Karine for two weeks with complete confidence.

You can tell Karine loves cats; she gives excellent advice, and we leave our cat and our keys in her care with complete peace of mind.
My cat Oslo is a regular and big fan of Karine's services. She's very reliable, always sends me photos, and I leave with peace of mind knowing he's in good hands. Highly recommended!

Karine has looked after our cat several times already. Everything has always gone well. Every day, we receive a visit report with (very good!) photos by text message. I highly recommend using Chat Heureux when you're away.
Very professional. Karine sends us photos of our cat when we travel, which is particularly appreciated. We always find our cat happy and it's clear he trusts her.

Karine is passionate about what she does!
During a trip of several days, she sent me photos and messages of my beloved cats after each visit. And when I returned, I found my home spotless 👌 and my sweet babies safe and sound.
Karine is exceptional!
Thank you 🙏

Our cats were so happy to see Karine every day! Chat Happy's services were amazing. The photos we received daily were gorgeous (the best photos we have of our cats). Karine is professional, efficient, and reliable. Perhaps it's just our imagination, but our cats seem happier and calmer after spending time with Karine.

Karine looked after my 1-year-old cat, Ernesto, for 20 days. She visited him twice a day and always sent me detailed updates and photos. She takes her work very seriously, knows cats well, and genuinely cares about their happiness. For example, Ernesto loves cardboard boxes, and since he had completely destroyed the one I had left him, Karine went to the supermarket on her own initiative to get him another one, just to make him happy :). When I returned from vacation, I found Ernesto in great shape, not at all stressed or bored. I highly recommend Karine's services!
We've used Chat Heureux several times for our cats, and everything has gone well. They are a reliable and trustworthy cat sitter.

Karine, a cat sitter and cat behaviorist, has been taking care of my cats for over 10 years, every holiday or long weekend. Very patient and attentive to my feline companions, she knows what they like and how to keep them entertained so …

Karine looked after my cat for several years. She is a superb cat sitter with great kindness. She quickly formed a very strong bond with my cat, so every time I went away, I was able to leave with peace of mind.

I've used Karine's services three times to look after my cat Maya while I'm away. Each time, it went wonderfully! The updates and lovely photos sent via text message after each visit are very reassuring. When I returned, I found Maya calm …
